title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear 1982 soundboard capture of a high‑energy show highlighted by an epic Crazy Fingers, though the playback runs slightly fast.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clean, crisp sound and captures one of ’82’s standout performances, with a killer opening sequence and a post‑revival Crazy Fingers that many call the best ever.  Listeners note a few mix quirks – Jerry Garcia’s vocals sit low and the whole tape plays back a bit faster than it should – but overall the show’s energy and tight playing make it a must‑have for Deadheads.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars, highlighting superb musical moments; recording quality is generally praised as clear though a few technical complaints lower it slightly, yielding an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear sound and excellent balance for most of the set; occasional ragged mix, Jerry’s vocals low in the mix, and playback runs faster than normal (pitch/tempo issue).

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, rock‑focused opening four‑song sequence; oddball but fun first set that keeps momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice sounds “helium” due to fast playback; guitar tone not specifically mentioned but overall playing praised.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (Keith) praised for authentic piano work on Touch of Grey.
